content.introduction: The 2026 U.S. economic calendar includes several key events: the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on December 1, 2026, the Employment Situation (Nonfarm Payrolls) on December 4, 2026, and the FOMC Rate Decision on December 9, 2026. The Consumer Price Index (CPI) is scheduled for December 10, 2026, and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on December 15, 2026. The Advance Monthly Retail Sales report is due on December 16, 2026, and the GDP (Third Estimate) for Q3 2026 on December 23, 2026. The FOMC Meeting Minutes for the October 27–28 meeting are scheduled for November 18, 2026. The GDP (Second Estimate) and Personal Income and Outlays (PCE Inflation) for Q3 2026 are both on November 25, 2026.
